query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS trade_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN realized_pnl > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "win_count!: i64", COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN realized_pnl < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "loss_count!: i64", SUM(realized_pnl) AS "total_realized_pnl: _" FROM positions WHERE wallet_address = ? AND status IN ('closed', 'rolled')
